summary: Taxiway A shoulder works at holding point A4 at EGTK; aircraft should keep west of the centreline and manoeuvre with caution.
text:
TWY A WIP ON SHOULDER AT HOLDING POINT A4 BTN 1.5M AND 26M E
OF CL. CODE A ACFT AND HELI DEVIATE W OF CL AND MANOEUVRE WITH 
CAUTION. CODE B AND CODE C ACFT EXPECT FOLLOW-ME.
